artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan repairing the duplication gate (dual-mode root resolution via the run-all.sh manifest probe, a new commands/skills/agents-scoped .md scan, deployed-mode and prose-exclusion regression fixtures), migrating all 38 real offenders (1 .sh + 37 .md across 7 extensions) to common_session_id(), and closing errors.json err_1787022038113_c3VPTR with evidence.

memory_candidates.content: A repository-hygiene gate whose scan scope is narrower than its defect class is worse than no gate: it reports safety while the class grows. The nvim agent-system's single-source session-ID gate scanned only *.sh while 37 of 38 real offenders were .md, and reported PASS as the class grew 43 -> 48 -> 52 sites over two weeks. The general design rule extracted: scope a duplication gate by POSITIVE inclusion of executable surfaces (commands/, skills/, agents/) rather than by a deny-list of documentation directories (context/, docs/, rules/) - a deny-list must grow with every new prose directory and fails open, while positive scoping fails closed. Pair this with probe-based root resolution (test for a known marker file at the candidate root) instead of a fixed-depth ../.. walk, which silently resolves to the wrong root when the same script is run from a deployed copy at a different directory depth.
